resources.title: Farming Guides & Practices
resources.description: Step-by-step tutorials on soil preparation, seasonal crop schedules, organic farming, and micro-drip irrigation.
resources.fullDetails: Comprehensive guide covering land tilling, organic compost application, seed germination testing, and water-saving precision micro-drip techniques tailored for optimal seasonal yield.
tips: Perform soil pH testing before applying chemical fertilizers
Use certified disease-resistant seed varieties for planting
Implement alternate wetting and drying (AWD) water management

resources.title: Crop Science & Profiles
resources.description: Catalog covering grains, fruits, vegetables, and cash crops with soil specs, climate requirements, and harvesting.
resources.fullDetails: Detailed catalog with soil requirements, recommended growth temperature (20°C - 32°C), harvesting schedules, and nutritional profiles for major cereal, vegetable, and cash crops.
tips: Ensure clay-loam soil for maximum moisture retention in rice
Maintain proper plant-to-plant spacing for airflow and sunlight
Apply balanced NPK ratios according to growth stage requirements

resources.title: Integrated Pest Control
resources.description: IPM techniques, biological insect controls, bio-neem remedies, and early pest symptom identification.
resources.fullDetails: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) guide featuring organic neem oil spray preparation, yellow sticky traps, predatory insect deployment, and early fungal blight detection.
tips: Inspect under leaf surfaces twice weekly for early pest infestation signs
Apply organic neem oil spray during early morning or late afternoon
Rotate crop families seasonally to break pest breeding life cycles

farmingGuides.title: Paddy Rice Cultivation Guide
farmingGuides.description: Complete guide from seed bed preparation, seedling transplanting, water management to harvesting.
farmingGuides.fullDetails: Comprehensive paddy rice production manual outlining field levelling, puddle tillage, 14-day seedling transplantation, weed management, and grain drying standards.
tips: Soak seeds for 24 hours prior to seedbed broadcasting
Maintain 2-3 cm standing water during tillering stage
Harvest when 80-85% of panicles turn golden yellow

farmingGuides.title: Soil Testing & NPK Fertilizer Management
farmingGuides.description: Understand soil pH levels, organic composting, and balanced NPK fertilizer application ratios.
farmingGuides.fullDetails: Soil fertility guide detailing soil core sampling, electrical conductivity testing, organic compost enrichment, and split application of Nitrogen (Urea), Phosphorus (TSP), and Potassium (MoP).
tips: Take 10-15 random soil core samples per acre for testing
Apply Phosphorus (TSP) completely during final land preparation
Split Nitrogen (Urea) into 3 equal top-dressings

farmingGuides.title: High Yield Vegetable Farming
farmingGuides.description: Modern greenhouse and open field vegetable production practices for maximum market yield.
farmingGuides.fullDetails: Horticultural production guide focusing on raised bed cultivation, plastic mulching for moisture retention, vertical trellis netting, and micro-nutrient foliar sprays.
tips: Use silver-black plastic mulch to suppress weeds and retain soil moisture
Prune lower yellow leaves to improve canopy ventilation
Foliar spray Boron and Calcium to prevent blossom end rot in tomatoes

farmingGuides.title: Smart Micro-Drip Irrigation Systems
farmingGuides.description: Conserve up to 60% water using gravity drip lines and solar-powered fertigation setups.
farmingGuides.fullDetails: Technical installation and maintenance guide for micro-drip emitters, sand filters, pressure regulators, and venturi fertigation injectors in high-value crop fields.
tips: Flush lateral drip lines every 15 days to remove silt sediment
Install a 120-mesh screen filter to prevent emitter clogging
Irrigate during early morning hours to minimize evaporative loss

cropDetails.name: Hybrid Paddy Rice (BRRI dhan29)
cropDetails.description: High-yielding cereal grain widely cultivated in South Asia with high resilience to lodging.
cropDetails.fullDetails: BRRI dhan29 is a premium Boro season rice variety producing 7.5 to 8.5 tons per hectare. Thrives in sub-flooded clay soils with proper NPK nutrient top-dressing at tillering and panicle initiation.
cropDetails.nutrients: High carbohydrate, energy-dense, source of B-vitamins

cropDetails.name: Bari Tomato 14 (Summer Variety)
cropDetails.description: Heat-tolerant, bacterial wilt-resistant tomato variety ideal for greenhouse and tunnel farming.
cropDetails.fullDetails: Bari Tomato 14 features uniform deep-red fruits weighing 80-100g each. Offers high vitamin C content and solid shelf-life, suited for fresh market supply and processing.
cropDetails.nutrients: Rich in Lycopene, Vitamin C, Vitamin A, Potassium

cropDetails.name: Yellow Maize / Corn (Pioneer 3355)
cropDetails.description: High starch grain used for poultry feed, flour production, and industrial biofuel extraction.
cropDetails.fullDetails: Robust maize hybrid with tight husk cover preventing cob-borer infestation. Yield potential ranges from 10-12 metric tons per hectare under optimal fertigation.

cropDetails.name: Organic Cavendish Banana
cropDetails.description: Fast-growing perennial fruit crop requiring windbreak barriers and heavy organic mulching.
cropDetails.fullDetails: Cavendish produces heavy bunches weighing 25-35 kg with sweet, seedless yellow fingers. Requires high Potassium fertilizer inputs and de-suckering management.
cropDetails.nutrients: Potassium, Vitamin B6, Dietary Fiber, Magnesium

pestControl.title: Yellow Stem Borer Management
pestControl.symptom: Dead hearts in vegetative stage and white heads at flowering stage
pestControl.remedy: Deploy Trichogramma egg parasitoids, install light traps, spray 5% Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE).
pestControl.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer, clip leaf tips before transplanting seedlings.

pestControl.title: Tomato Late Blight Control
pestControl.symptom: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf edges and white mold growth beneath leaves
pestControl.remedy: Foliar spray copper oxychloride or Trichoderma harzianum bio-fungicide during high humidity.
pestControl.prevention: Maintain wide plant spacing, practice crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.

pestControl.title: Fall Armyworm (FAW) IPM Strategy
pestControl.symptom: Ragged holes on whorl leaves and sawdust-like frass inside crop whorls
pestControl.remedy: Apply Spinetoram or Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) dust directly into crop whorls.
pestControl.prevention: Intercrop maize with cowpea or desmodium, deploy pheromone lure traps early.

faqs.question: What is the primary mission of the Agricultural Information Hub (Agri-Hub)?
faqs.answer: Agri-Hub is a free digital platform dedicated to empowering farmers and extension agents with scientific crop information, seasonal calendars, IPM pest remedies, and direct access to agricultural specialists.

faqs.question: How can I request a soil test for my agricultural land?
faqs.answer: You can fill out our Specialist Advisory form on the Contact page or visit your nearest Upazila Agriculture Office (DAE). Collect 10-15 soil core samples at a 15cm depth across your plot for accurate lab testing.

faqs.question: What are organic alternatives to synthetic chemical pesticides?
faqs.answer: Organic options include 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE), yellow & blue sticky pheromone traps, biopesticides like Trichoderma and Bacillus thuringiensis, and encouraging natural predators like ladybird beetles.

faqs.question: What is Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) in paddy farming?
faqs.answer: AWD is a water-saving technology where paddy fields are allowed to dry periodically until water level drops 15 cm below soil surface before re-flooding. This saves up to 30% irrigation water without reducing yield.
